messages:
jess: Pushed a new candidate vector model to staging (raven-mini-v2 int6). Quick sanity run shows a drop on short-query recall@5. tagging @sasha @mike for visibility.

sasha: :eyes: can you paste the eval slice and command you ran?

jess: Ran holdout sweep on 10k short queries (len<=20). Command: 
```bash
python eval/recall.py --model raven-mini-v2 --quant int6 --slice short_queries --k 5 --dataset holdout_10k
```
Results:
```
slice            recall@1  recall@5  recall@10
short_queries    0.558     0.732     0.812
baseline (raven-1)0.568    0.776     0.845
delta            -0.010    -0.044    -0.033
```

jess: So biggest hit is recall@5 (~4.4% absolute). recall@1 less impacted.

taylor: Interesting — int6 per-channel vs global? Which quant path did you use? sometimes per-channel helps short queries.

jess: This was int6 global (faster path we wanted to try). I have a per-channel build queued but not finished.

mike: Could this be KV-cache / prefix handling difference for short seqs? Any change in normalization or embedding L2 norm post-quant?

sasha: Also check whitening/whitespace tokenization differences. Short queries often sensitive to stopword handling.

jess: Good point. I re-ran small sample comparing norms: avg L2 for golden model 0.98 vs raven-mini-v2 int6 0.94 — small shift. After L2 renorm recall improved ~1%.

jess: Quick ablation I just ran:
```text
- no norm: recall@5 0.71
- L2 renorm: recall@5 0.73
- per-channel int6 (wip): recall@5 0.74 (estimated)
```

taylor: Nice. If per-channel moves it another +1%, we might be within noise. Also check cluster stability (UMAP/TSNE) for anchor groups, short queries sometimes move cluster centroids.

sasha: Can you post a diff of UMAP for the 'faq' anchor group? I can run a quick silhouette score.

jess: Uploading two tiny PNGs to #eng-ml-artifacts (links below). gist: a few anchors shift to neighboring clusters for the quantized model. silhouette drop ~0.03 on that cohort.

mike: Given small absolute deltas, plan: 1) finish per-channel quant build, 2) run renorm fix in inference client, 3) run an A/B rolling canary on ~1% of traffic with fallback. If metrics stable, we can keep int6.

jess: Agreed. I'll prioritize per-channel build and a quick regression-run across other slices (long queries, multilingual). ETA EOD.

sasha: For the A/B, also include recall@1 and reranking NDCG slice for conversational prompts.

jess: Will do.

eden-bot: deployment: raven-mini-v2-int6-perchannel build started (build id: bld_78321). ETA ~45m.

taylor: Also add a tiny synthetic perturbation test: add 1-char noise, punctuation shifts for short queries. If quantization amplifies brittleness, we should see bigger delta.

jess: Good call. Adding that to the runbook. I'll post a short summary in this thread once results in. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
